client_instance_id, user_id, client_name, platform, architecture, client_version, opencode_version, created_at, updated_at, last_connected_at, last_disconnected_at

mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM local_client_credentials WHERE client_key_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_client_credentials( user_id, encrypted_client_key, client_key_fingerprint, key_hint, version, status, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{encryptedClientKey}, #{clientKeyFingerprint}, #{keyHint}, #{version}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{revokedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET encrypted_client_key = EXCLUDED.encrypted_client_key, client_key_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.client_key_fingerprint, key_hint = EXCLUDED.key_hint, version = EXCLUDED.version, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, revoked_at = EXCLUDED.revoked_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM local_client_instances WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, client_instance_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_client_instances( client_instance_id, user_id, client_name, platform, architecture, client_version, opencode_version, created_at, updated_at, last_connected_at, last_disconnected_at ) VALUES ( #{clientInstanceId}, #{userId}, #{clientName}, #{platform}, #{architecture}, #{clientVersion}, #{opencodeVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastConnectedAt}, #{lastDisconnectedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (client_instance_id) DO UPDATE SET client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, architecture = EXCLUDED.architecture, client_version = EXCLUDED.client_version, opencode_version = EXCLUDED.opencode_version, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, last_connected_at = EXCLUDED.last_connected_at, last_disconnected_at = EXCLUDED.last_disconnected_at WHERE local_client_instances.user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM local_client_workspaces WHERE client_instance_id = #{clientInstanceId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, workspace_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_client_workspaces( workspace_id, user_id, client_instance_id, normalized_root_path, root_digest, file_system_identity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{clientInstanceId}, #{normalizedRootPath}, #{rootDigest}, #{fileSystemIdentity}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET normalized_root_path = EXCLUDED.normalized_root_path, root_digest = EXCLUDED.root_digest, file_system_identity = EXCLUDED.file_system_identity, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE local_client_workspaces.user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id AND local_client_workspaces.client_instance_id = EXCLUDED.client_instance_id
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM local_client_rollout_users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = TRUE
SELECT user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM local_client_rollout_users WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY updated_at DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM local_client_rollout_users WHERE enabled = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_client_rollout_users(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{updatedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.updated_by_user_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

MERGE INTO local_client_rollout_users target USING (VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{updatedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})) incoming(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) ON target.user_id = incoming.user_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET enabled = incoming.enabled, updated_by_user_id = incoming.updated_by_user_id, updated_at = incoming.updated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(user_id, enabled, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(incoming.user_id, incoming.enabled, incoming.updated_by_user_id, incoming.created_at, incoming.updated_at)
